lots.working: No same-item SOLD evidence survives (the Gowans puzzle hammers are unrelated mixed lots), so both caps are 0 under the rules. For context only: six puzzles at roughly A$20 to A$43 new retail is about A$150 retail; resold singly they would need to fight new stock that is still available, and postage on a 500 piece box eats much of a $15 to $25 sale.
lots.confidence_reason: Titles are read clearly in the photo, but evidence is asking prices only (some expired); no sold result for any title.

(2) Walmart US$29.99: page returned a bot check, unverified. (3) Both eBay entries (167003335231, 395703706515): eBay closed to us, snippet only. (4) Etsy US$36: HTTP 403, and different titles from the lot. Changed: Rockabilia GnR is the exact title (US$29.99), RareVinyl price corrected to US$36.99 and marked sold out, Puzzle Warehouse and Music Box Pyromania marked expired. lots.working: Keep: lowest close SOLD = $120 (lot 395431); 120 / 1.198 = 100.2, round down to $100 (all-in $119.80). Flip: likely resale taken as the average of the two close SOLD hammers, (120 + 300) / 2 = $210, sold on Facebook Marketplace or Gumtree with $0 fee and buyer collects (no outbound postage); 210 / 2.396 = 87.6, round down to $85. If a van or removalist is needed to get it home from 37 Main Road, Moonah, that cost comes off both figures.
lots.confidence_reason: Clear identification from three photos and two close Gowans SOLD results (API opened, photos compared), but no maker label seen and comparables are similar, not identical.
